title: calawaya elata
intro: Calawaya elata, commonly known as Andean maca, is a perennial plant native to the Andean highlands of South America. The health benefits of Calawaya elata include its potential to support hormonal balance, improve fertility, and enhance energy levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its adaptogenic effects, which help the body adapt to stress, and its ability to regulate menstrual cycles and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The bioactive constituents of Calawaya elata include alkaloids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine.
